name: code-review
description: Review a committed GitHub diff on separate Standards and Spec axes with strict child-chat isolation.
adaptations: Use connected GitHub capabilities against committed refs and pull requests instead of local Git commands or tracker indirection.
Keep Standards and Spec as separate axes while distinguishing documented rules, established repository conventions, and heuristic smells.
Run strict mode in two separate ChatGPT conversations outside the same Project, with independent direct GitHub access and no cross-sharing of findings.
Stop strict mode when either child lacks direct GitHub access; offer a clearly labeled non-isolated fallback only after explicit user permission.
Treat reference chat history as a user-controlled prerequisite the MCP cannot inspect, and document a two-child synthetic-canary smoke procedure as confidence evidence rather than formal proof.
